length_in.note: 2025 Jeep Wagoneer S Specifications (sources/stellantis-2025-wagoneer-s-specifications.pdf). Text extraction offsets values from labels; read in row order (wheelbase 113.0, tracks 64.4/64.5, overall length 192.4, width at mirrors 83.6, body width 74.8).

width_in.note: 'Body width' 74.8 in; 'Overall width (width at mirrors)' 83.6 in.

caranddriver.note: Listed among earlier model years on the page titled '2025 Jeep Wagoneer S Review, Pricing, and Specs'.

awd.note: 'Four-wheel drive' listed under body and chassis; spec sheet covers Launch Edition and Limited.

adapter.note: Jeep's Wagoneer S technology page: 'Starting early 2026, the Jeep Wagoneer S is adopting the North American Charging System, adding more than 27,500 Tesla Supercharger stalls to our expansive network', beside an 'Integrated Charging Adapter' with a shop link, 'Tesla Supercharging Compatible'. Stellantis release (https://media.stellantisnorthamerica.com/newsrelease.do?id=27259&mid=): 'Tesla Supercharger network availability will start in 2026 with existing North American BEVs, such as Jeep Wagoneer S'.
